preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= n0 <= 100 and 0 <= n1 <= 100 and 0 <= n2 <= 100 for n0, n1, n2 in zip(n0_list, n1_list, n2_list))
preconditions.description: Each n0, n1, n2 is between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(n0 + n1 + n2 > 0 for n0, n1, n2 in zip(n0_list, n1_list, n2_list))
preconditions.description: At least one of n0, n1, n2 is greater than 0.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and all(c in '01' for c in line) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a binary string.
